answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that only earns voting weight after a slow, terrace-like ramp of verified work. Sybil copies gain nothing instantly: each cloned identity must lock its own capital and survive the same ramp. Peers score the delta between promised and delivered output, slashing the stake of liars. Like yarrow that spreads only where its roots actually take hold, influence accrues to agents doing real work, so a swarm of empty identities costs far more than it can ever extract.
